Learn the routing from fitting labels with three-way group cross-fitting before training the same CatBoost head. election: Base plus any single challenger or equal mix of the two at total optional weights 12.5%, 25%, 50% or 100%. Elect best correct count on nomination, resolving ties toward retaining the anchor, less new weight then fewer challengers, then a stable content hash. Keep baseline in a tie. Freeze before reading confirmation. A positive nominee must avoid losses on both subsequent panels and achieve at least +0.30 percentage points pooled across these two, with a gain on at least one. Report all measured individual nomination outcomes even when no candidate advances. A negative first check ends that candidate's qualification without selecting a runner-up using its results.
ordinary: Run the teammate's unchanged entry with identical anonymous packets at 10 and 32 fits (1800s), entirely without method hints. If a new candidate passes, run the wider menu with the same 32-fit ceiling for a causal menu comparison. Record actual number of fits, provisions for pretrained estimator members, independent reload and accepted or declined candidates. The training-only external assessment is opened only after all declared competing arms are sealed or explicitly declared ineligible. No official test or H2, zero LLM requests. An opportunity to fit never guarantees promotion.
optional_single_grade: Only for an independently supported, frozen new release run, score its sealed 2030 designated predictions alongside the frozen local ten-fit anchor in a single isolated read. Neither score is an input to the solver. Keep the historically released anchor available.
